title: Rubrik Part 1
description:
Hello! Welcome to today’s episode of the Healthcare Security Brief podcast, where we will explore the evolving landscape of cybersecurity and the partnerships helping healthcare organizations stay resilient.


Today, we’re excited to have Josh Howell, Healthcare CTO of Rubrik. Rubrik is a leading cloud data management and security company that provides comprehensive solutions for data protection, recovery, and management across hybrid cloud environments. In part 1 of our discussion with Josh, we dig into topics such as cyber resilience, security of last resort, the healthcare defender, attacks at the identity layer and much more.

title: IBM Security Part 2
description:
Join us for part two of our conversation with Salwa Rafee and Dr. Bonnie Netschert from IBM Security as we explore how healthcare organizations can move beyond compliance checklists and use compliance as code to reduce risk and strengthen security outcomes. The discussion covers embedding security and privacy controls into infrastructure, automating evidence collection, and making secure development practices easier for healthcare teams. We also examine how managed services, AI, and automation can help address ongoing cybersecurity talent shortages while enabling resilient 24/7 security operations and improving readiness against evolving threats. If you missed part one, be sure to listen for additional insights on today's healthcare threat landscape and modern cybersecurity strategies.

title: Series Introduction
description:
We're excited to introduce a new podcast series called the Microsoft Healthcare Security Brief. The objective of this new podcast series is to bring together some of our strategic partners in the healthcare security space for a personal discussion on topics we feel can help healthcare organizations be more resilient and proactive across the evolving threat landscape, and hear firsthand some of the experiences and recommendations our partners can share.
